Customer noticed after SSO provisioning yesterday. Screenshot: https://redwood-files/acme/shot.png

```json
{"event":"promo_applied","workspace":"ws_3021","promo":"TRIAL-2026","applied_by":"system-sso-sync","timestamp":"2026-03-17T15:12:03Z"}
```

maria-cs: Customer sent explicit approval in support ticket #8421 (they replied "please move the trial credits to our prod workspace"). They confirm the amount is $500.

frank: OK prepping ledger & transfer. Internal change I'll run once documented. Example of the update we'll do (internal):
```sql
UPDATE credits
SET workspace_id='ws_1111', note='moved per support #8421'
WHERE workspace_id='ws_3021' AND promo_code='TRIAL-2026' AND org_id='org_98765';
```

samir: follow-up item for eng-infra: add a guard to the SSO/SCIM sync to prefer existing workspace matches by external_id/domain before creating a new workspace. Filing infra ticket INFRA-1142 and assign to @eng-infra.

olivia: tagging @credits-ops for reconciliation & audit trail. maria please confirm once frank finishes the transfer so we can close the ticket. :thumbsup:
